headline: Executive order sets up a commission to look at how well U.S. intelligence agencies handle information about weapons of mass destruction.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a commission focused on the intelligence capabilities of the United States regarding weapons of mass destruction. No summary was provided, so details such as the commission's members, powers, deadlines, and specific tasks are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Their ability to gather and assess information about weapons of mass destruction appears to be the subject of the commission's work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 6, 2004; no separate effective date was provided.
